# ADR 0003: Pure scoring function

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** Credit-card default risk scorecard API

## Context

Scoring must be fast, deterministic and testable at boundaries.

## Decision

The engine takes a profile and a rule set and returns score, grade, action and reason codes; no I/O inside.

## Consequences

Trivial unit tests; safe to run in parallel.

## Alternatives considered

Scoring inside SQL (hard to explain and test).
